title: revisionTime
responsibility: Finds the authored timestamp of the selected commit or the current branch tip.

inputs.name: revisionTime.snapshot
inputs.description: Project snapshot supplying revision.commit, revision.tip and the commits list to search by hash. A null snapshot matches no commit, so the result is null.

capabilities.reason: Comments are saved as local pending drafts until connected.

inputs.name: revisionTime.kind
inputs.description: Selects the hash to match: 'branch' uses revision.tip and 'commit' uses revision.commit. Any other runtime value takes the 'commit' path.

inputs.name: displayTime.value
inputs.description: Timestamp string to format; null, an empty string, or a string Date.parse cannot read produces the 'Unknown' label.

outputs.name: revisionTime
outputs.description: The matched commit's committedAt, or its authoredAt when committedAt is absent, returned as stored without formatting. It is null when the snapshot is null, no commit has the hash chosen by kind, or the matched commit has neither timestamp.

outputs.name: displayTime
outputs.description: A localized date and time in the runtime's default locale, shown as medium date and short time, or the literal 'Unknown' when the input is null, empty, or not parseable as a date.
